name: Lootale Slash
summary: Lootale Slash is a free-to-play online action RPG with pixel art visuals, playable in the browser, on Android and iOS, and coming soon to Steam. Pick one of seven classes and explore a shared, persistent open world where every player on the map fights side by side in real time. Team up with friends to raid procedurally generated co-op dungeons, take down world bosses and region bosses, and fight for loot that drops at the level of each zone. Build your hero your way: collect and enchant weapons and armor, upgrade item potential, hatch and raise pets, unlock skills and progress through the Arkanyta talent tree. Join a guild, trade with other players, chat, and keep growing even while you’re away with Expeditions.
